note: Sixth review of 1.24.13: 77 small P1AM sketches whose behaviour the reviewer knew, each run scan by scan by Lantern's sketch interpreter (CODE_SCAN) and as real C++ (g++ with a stand-in P1AM library: int 32 bits, wrapping as the SAMD21 does). c is what C gave at each scan (outputs on/off; whole-module writes to slots 9 to 15 as numbers, sN). On the build it was given, 18 differed: a bool not made 0 or 1, integer sizes, float division and casts, octal and character literals, a #define put in brackets or defined again. Replayed by tests/bench_1253.js.
